Fictional credit union tests instant transfers

Fictional Harbor Credit Union began testing instant transfers between five local institutions under a shared settlement agreement.

The trial will track transfer completion times, returned payments and customer support requests through the end of the quarter.

Participating institutions will publish a joint review before deciding whether to add more banks and credit unions to the service.

Fictional operations director Morgan Hale said the group will use measured results before making a permanent change.
